spec.books: week = full ISO weekly grid; week_near_me = the same grid cut to one decision per month at the weekly session nearest the boundary; the gap is each book against month-end

honest: the screen repairs arithmetic impossibility only; a flagged ETF print may be genuine, so 'neutralise' is a sensitivity face, not a truth
drop mode changes the universe size, so its delta mixes the correction with a composition change; the two neutralise columns isolate it

week_near_me holds the trading frequency fixed against month-end, so it is the book that prices the DATE; the raw weekly gap mixes calendar with a ~4.3x higher rebalance rate and is published for context only
turnover columns are the control that the screen moves the return path and not the traded book
cost x3 is a stress face on the frozen 13.041bp/side, not a fee forecast
gapped prints are never repaired, so a residual carried by a behind-suspension print would read flat here rather than corrected
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial booking
